title: New Truck
kidsText: Your old truck still runs. A new one has heated seats. Pay cash or take a loan.
adultText: The old one still runs, but this one has heated seats. Pay cash or take the dealer's loan.

title: Family Beach Week
kidsText: A week at the beach for the whole family. Fun, but it costs real money.
adultText: Seven nights, four people, one rented house by the ocean. Memories are not a monthly bill, but the trip is.

title: Big Screen and Sound System
kidsText: A giant TV and big speakers. The store will let you pay a little each month.
adultText: Wall-sized television and speakers you can feel. The store offers no-money-down financing.
